resources.string: The cover with a knob that shows how far into the song you are. Tap the knob to pause.
Four pins. Tap one to play it.
Cover, song, progress and transport buttons.
Now Playing with the next three songs from Up Next.
One Now Playing widget. Drag its handles and it changes layout: 2x1, 4x1 strip with a Pins page, 2x2, 4x2 or 4x4.
